mapper.sql: id, order_no, user_id, group_id, vip_level, order_type, quota_type, quota_count, price_yuan, status, created_at, activated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vip_order (order_no, user_id, group_id, vip_level, order_type, quota_type, quota_count, price_yuan, status, created_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{groupId}, #{vipLevel}, #{orderType}, #{quotaType}, #{quotaCount}, #{priceYuan}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM vip_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT o.order_no, o.user_id, u.nickname, u.phone, u.email, o.vip_level, o.order_type, o.quota_type, o.quota_count, o.price_yuan, o.created_at FROM vip_order o LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = #{pendingStatus} ORDER BY o.created_at ASC

SELECT o.order_no, o.user_id, u.nickname, u.phone, u.email, o.vip_level, o.order_type, o.quota_type, o.quota_count, o.price_yuan, o.status, o.created_at, o.activated_at FROM vip_order o LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = o.user_id
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vip_order o LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = o.user_id
